value.rationale: An unbiased two-atom gradient oracle is natural for stochastic optimization. The exact 1/N skewness scale identifies when increasingly aggressive clipping converts an order-one distributed stationary error into an order-one biased endpoint despite centered noise. At exact symmetry, an explicit O(N^2) degradation in effective averaging cost coexists with a threefold reduction in stationary iterate variance; this is a mathematically motivated diagnostic for clipped optimization and temporal correlation, not an arbitrary tabulation. Limits to a scalar model are explicit.
